name: barbell deadlift (front pov)
description: The barbell deadlift seen from the front. A strong lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
